list.count: {count, plural, one {# QR code} other {# QR codes}}
list.empty: No QR codes yet. Each code gets its own short link, so you can change where it goes after printing.
list.emptyFiltered: No QR codes match these filters.

overview.created: QR code created. Download it below, or adjust the design first.
overview.downloadHint: Exactly as shown, at the size you pick. SVG scales to any print size.

form.newDescription: Point it at a URL or one of your links, then design it. The destination can change after printing.
form.editDescription: Where the code goes and how it's filed. The pattern never changes, so printed copies follow.
form.urlEditHint: Printed copies follow the new destination on the next scan.
form.orLink: Or use one of your links:
form.attachHint: It's attached to that link, so you'll find it on the link's QR code tab.
form.replacesCode: This link already has a QR code; the new one becomes its code. The old code keeps scanning.
form.title: Title
form.titleHint: Helps you find the code later.
form.noTags: No tags in this workspace yet.
form.applyToLinkHint: Copies a new destination or title to the link this code is attached to.
form.previewHint: The preview uses a sample short link; your code gets its own when you create it.

design.description: Colours, shapes and logo. The link inside the code stays the same.
design.printed: This is the code as it prints today.

deletePage.title: {count, plural, one {Delete QR code} other {Delete # QR codes}}
deletePage.notAllowed: You can only delete QR codes you created; the others are left out.
deletePage.stopsScanning: {count, plural, one {The code stops scanning right away, because its short link is deleted with it.} other {The codes stop scanning right away, because their short links are deleted with them.}}
deletePage.history: Scan history is archived and no longer shown.
deletePage.attached: Attached links keep working; they just lose their QR code.
deletePage.permanent: Printed copies can't be brought back.
deletePage.confirm: {count, plural, one {Delete QR code} other {Delete # QR codes}}

preview.label: Preview
preview.altNew: Preview of the new QR code

colors.title: Colours
colors.gradients: This code uses colour gradients from the previous editor. They're kept as printed and take priority over the colours below.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: Shapes change the look; the link inside stays the same.

errorLevel.title: Error correction
errorLevel.description: Higher levels let a code survive scuffs and a logo, at the cost of a denser pattern.
errorLevel.label: Level

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: Drawn in the middle of the code.
logo.urlHint: Upload an image, then save the design to use it.
logo.sizeHint: How much of the error correction the logo takes up. Keep it at 50% or less.
logo.hideDots: Hide the pattern behind the logo
logo.gatedExisting: Your plan no longer includes logos. You can keep this one or remove it.

check.title: Scan check
check.contrastOk: Good contrast ({value}). Phones read it easily.
check.contrastLow: Low contrast ({value}). Test it with a few phones before printing.
check.contrastFail: Too little contrast ({value}). Many phones won't read it: darken the code or lighten the background.
check.unknownColor: These colours can't be checked automatically. Test the code before printing.
check.inverted: Light code on a dark background. Some older scanner apps can't read inverted codes.
check.transparent: The background is see-through, so contrast depends on what it's printed on.
check.logoLarge: The logo takes up {value} of the error correction. Keep it at 50% or less so a scuffed print still reads.
check.logoSmall: With error correction L or M the logo is drawn small. Choose Q or H for a larger logo.
check.logoUnavailable: The logo didn't load, so the preview leaves it out. Check the URL and that its server allows cross-origin requests.

download.logoFailed: The logo couldn't be loaded, so the download would be missing it.

errors.invalidUrl: Enter a full URL, like https://example.com/page.
errors.unsafeDestination: This destination can't be used. It points to a private or unsafe address.
errors.limitReached: You've created all {limit} QR codes your plan includes this month.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this in this workspace.
errors.notFound: This QR code no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
errors.invalidInput: Some fields are too long or not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
errors.urlRequired: Enter the URL the code should open.
errors.logoUrl: Enter the logo's full URL, starting with https://.
errors.color: Every colour needs a value of up to 32 characters, like #0f172b.
